The backend function handling the SignIn RPC has been identified.

`APIV1Service.SignIn` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` handles the SignIn RPC. The proto defines the `rpc SignIn` on `AuthService`. `APIV1Service` embeds `v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer` and implements the method directly. `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` delegates to it. The gRPC gateway registers `APIV1Service` as the `AuthService` handler.
